ideas.title: Investigating the Minneapolis ICE Shooting
ideas.description: A thorough investigation into the shooting of Alex Pretti and the Trump administration's response.
questions: What led to the shooting of Alex Pretti?
How has the Trump administration responded to the shooting?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a larger issue with the Trump administration's handling of extremist groups and their response to violent incidents. I recommend investigating the administration's policies and actions leading up to the shooting.
